note: decode_line_info() (bfd/dwarf2.c) reads the DWARF line-number-program header field `lh.line_range` directly from an attacker-supplied object file. The DW_LNS_const_add_pc standard-opcode handler divides `(255 - lh.opcode_base) / lh.line_range` at both its taken branches (lh.maximum_ops_per_insn == 1 and its else). A zero line_range triggers SIGFPE.

(255 - lh.opcode_base) / lh.line_range : integer divide-by-zero (DW_LNS_const_add_pc, maximum_ops_per_insn == 1 branch)
lh.line_range : unsigned char, read from the attacker-controlled DWARF line-number-program header
